A '''shrine''' depicting their gods was built by the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], but was buried by volcanic dust until it was discovered and excavated during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The shrine contained technology designed to "speak" to the planet's [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Fire-Lords of Sullust}}</ref>
